Tổng hoành độ các giao điểm của mặt cầu <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>:</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></semantics></math> bằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

Khoảng cách từ tâm của mặt cầu <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> đến trục <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></semantics></math> bằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

Mặt cầu <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> đi qua điểm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>

variants.solution: Mặt cầu <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có tâm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>14</mn></mrow></semantics></math>. Đường thẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow></semantics></math> chính là đường thẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></semantics></math> nên cắt <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> tại <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow></semantics></math> và <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có tổng hoành độ bằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></semantics></math>.
